Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the quick onboarding intake earlier. We are ready to move forward with vendor setup but have a couple of constraints on the US-centric notarization steps. MarlinTech S.p.A. (Italy) completed the W-8BEN-E draft — attached — and our legal team prefers an EU notary followed by an apostille rather than a US notary stamp.

Quick questions:
- Will Redwood accept an EU notarial certificate + apostille (Italian Prefettura) as equivalent evidence for the W-8BEN-E signer?
- If not, are alternate documents (bank reference letter + corporate registry extract + signer authorization on company letterhead) sufficient to provision a provisional PO?

We have a scanned bank letter and can route a DocuSign signer-authority form if that speeds things up. We want to avoid delaying the first delivery window (target week of April 10). Can you confirm what will allow us to get purchase-order provisioning with minimal hold?

Attachments: marlintech_w8ben-e_draft.pdf, marlintech_bank_letter.pdf

Best,

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the W-8BEN-E draft and the bank letter; appreciated. Short answer: yes, we can accept an EU notarial certificate plus apostille as valid evidence for the W-8BEN-E signer in most cases. There are two practical paths depending on how quickly you can deliver documents and whether you can provide a signer-authority declaration:

Option A — Acceptable (preferred for EU entities):
- Notarized signature on W-8BEN-E (local Italian notary) with apostille attached.
- Company registry extract (Registro delle Imprese) showing the signer's authority.
- Bank reference letter (attached is acceptable).
Result: We can provision a provisional PO once we have scanned apostille + registry extract; full release after procurement/legal does the final validation.

Option B — Alternative (if apostille delayed):
- Remote video-notarization (e-notarization) or DocuSign with signer authentication +
- Company letter on headed paper authorizing the signer (signed by an officer), plus registry extract and bank letter.
Result: We may provision a provisional PO with a conservative spend cap until we receive the apostille.

For speed, procurement will issue a provisional PO with a temporary cap of $20,000 USD until we have final validated evidence. If MarlinTech can get the apostille and registry extract within 7 business days we can lift the cap and finalize onboarding. Please confirm you accept the $20k provisional cap so we can create the PO record.

I cc'd Laura (procurement) and Karthik (tax/legal) to keep approvals moving — Laura will kick off the DocuSign if you prefer that route. I attached our internal procurement checklist so you can see the exact docs we need.

Procurement checklist: procurement-checklist.pdf

Elena —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Answers below:

1) DocuSign: I created the signer-authority envelope and shared the link — https://docusign.com/MB-REDF-12345 — Laura will receive a copy once signed.

2) $20k cap semantics: the cap is an aggregate provisional spend limit across all provisional POs issued while onboarding is incomplete. We can issue multiple POs but the combined provisional liability will not exceed $20,000 until we receive and validate the apostille + registry extract. Once we have those, procurement/legal will lift the provisional aggregate cap and convert provisional POs to standard POs.

3) Timeline: if MarlinTech uploads the DocuSign-signed authorization and the registry extract + bank letter by EOD next Wednesday (2028-04-06), we will remove the cap and finalize setup by Friday (2028-04-08). If the apostille arrives earlier, we can accelerate.

Next steps (for clarity):
- Elena: sign DocuSign envelope + upload registry extract to the DocuSign envelope or reply with PDF copy.
- MarlinTech: send scanned apostille when available.
- Redwood (Laura): create provisional PO(s) up to an aggregate $20,000 and share PO number(s).
- Karthik/legal: will perform the tax-form verification once apostille and registry extract are in.

I've filed a procurement ticket (PROC-4789) to track this onboarding. If everyone confirms, Laura will post the provisional PO this afternoon.
